svg.title: I0 manufactured mechanics and simulated FORCE/LPT pilot
svg.desc: Six panels show latent body, bar, and system center of mass; prescribed latent support force and simulated FORCE observations with missing samples; simulated cable length against latent bar height; cable rate against latent vertical bar velocity; independent FORCE and LPT clock offsets; and the declared stance-to-flight event. All records are manufactured or simulated and are not empirical validation.
svg.text: Manufactured scenario; explicit clocks; missing samples remain gaps
Simulation time (s; observed time uses declared clock map)
C. Cable length and bar height
Simulation time (s; LPT native clock mapped)
D. Cable rate and vertical bar velocity
Simulation time (s; LPT native clock mapped)
E. Native clock offset from simulation time
Simulation time (s; from declared clock maps)
F. Declared contact schedule and event
Manufactured latent mechanics and simulated observations only; gap marks missing data, not zero. Biological and device validity are not established.
